attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Logs (T1562.008)
attackers_goals: Evade detection by automatically deleting audit logs.
description: A retention policy was set on a S3 bucket used by a CloudTrail Trail, using a S3 Lifecycle Rule.
investigative_actions: Review the new S3 bucket lifecycle policy. Check The cloud identity activity prior/after to the lifecycle policy modification.
name: AWS S3 bucket data retention policy change through S3 Lifecycle rule
